# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left, with "Welcome - user - Visual Studio Code" centered.
- **System Date and Time**: "Oct 23 02:17" is displayed in the center of the title bar.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the right side of the title bar, including:
  - Network/Connection icon
  - Sound/volume control icon
  - Power button icon
- **Window Control Buttons**: Three buttons on the far right of the title bar:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: A horizontal menu bar with the following items from left to right:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Icons (Top to Bottom)**:
  - **File Explorer Icon**: A folder icon, currently active.
  - **Search Icon**: A magnifying glass icon.
  - **Source Control Icon**: A branching diagram icon.
  - **Debug Icon**: A bug icon.
  - **Extensions Icon**: A square with a plus sign icon.
  - **Terminal Icon**: A command prompt icon.
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear icon.
  - **User Icon**: A person silhouette icon.
  - **Grid Icon**: A 3x3 grid icon (application launcher).
- **Sidebar Content**:
  - **Explorer Panel**: Displays the file system structure under the "USER" directory.
  - **Folder Structure**:
    - USER (expanded)
      - .cache
      - .config
      - .gnupg
      - .ipython
      - .local
      - .mozilla
      - .pki
      - .ssh
      - .thunderbird
      - .var
      - .vscode
      - Desktop
      - Documents
      - Downloads
      - Music
      - Pictures
      - project
      - Public
      - server
      - snap
      - Templates
      - Videos
      - .bash_history
      - .bash_logout
      - .bashrc
      - .lesshst
      - .profile
      - .selected_editor
      - .sudo_as_admin_successful
      - .viminfo
      - requirement.txt
  - **Panel Sections**:
    - OUTLINE (collapsed)
    - TIMELINE (collapsed)

## Main Editor Area

- **Active Tab**: "Welcome" tab is active, indicated by a blue icon and the tab title.
- **Welcome Page Content**:
  - **Title**: "Visual Studio Code"
  - **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved"
  - **Start Section**:
    - New File...
    - Open File...
    - Open Folder
    - Connect to...
  - **Recent Section**:
    - project
  - **Walkthroughs Section**:
    - "Getting started with VS Code"
    - "Organize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding"
    - "The Fundamentals"
- **Trust Dialog Box**:
  - **Title**: "Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?"
  - **Icon**: A blue shield with a keyhole.
  - **Description Text**:
    - "Code provides features that may automatically execute files in this folder."
    - "If you don't trust the authors of these files, we recommend to continue in restricted mode as the files may be malicious. See our docs to learn more."
    - Path: "/home/user"
  - **Checkbox**:
    - "Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'home'"
  - **Buttons**:
    - "No, I don't trust the authors" (gray button, labeled "Browse folder in restricted mode")
    - "Yes, I trust the authors" (blue button, labeled "Trust folder and enable all features")
- **Checkbox**:
  - "Show welcome page on startup" (checked)

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Status Indicators**:
  - **Git Status**: Three icons indicating no changes (0 commits, 0 additions, 0 deletions).
  - **Screen Reader Optimized**: Text indicating the interface is optimized for screen readers.
- **Icons**:
  - **Git Status Icons**: Three icons (circle with a plus, circle with a minus, circle with a checkmark) followed by "0 0 0".
  - **Screen Reader Optimized Icon**: A screen reader icon on the far right.

## System Environment

- **Desktop Environment**: Ubuntu-based desktop environment, indicated by the "Activities" button on the top-left corner.
